notes: `upstream`/`image`/`tag`/`full` describe the base image the extended Dockerfile FROMs. It now points at the Isol8 fork (Isol8AI/agent) built from upstream OpenClaw 2026.6.1 plus the bundled-MCP fixes (non-blocking materialization + shared runtime scope); tag scheme is `<upstream-version>-isol8.<n>`. `extendedImage` + per-env `dev.tag`/`prod.tag` are the ECR-published extended image deployed to dev and prod (re-stamped by build-openclaw-image.yml on each base/extended build).
